title: object
description: One of the two kinds of data in a category — but not a primitive here. An object is recovered from its morphisms: it is fully determined (up to isomorphism) by the representable presheaf Hom(−, A), its bundle of incoming arrows (Yoneda). It has no internal substance the arrows fail to capture; it is identified with its identity morphism.

determined-by-arrows.description: the object is fully determined by Hom(−, A), its bundle of incoming arrows (Yoneda); two objects with the same incoming arrows from every object are isomorphic

identity.description: the identity morphism id_A with which the object is identified
